_note: DEMO DATA. Obligations and the other-chain balance are NOT on-chain. The NEAR/USD price is a fixed demo number (1 test NEAR = $1,000), not a market price. Real balances come from the DAO (the reserve) and its payroll account on NEAR testnet. Payouts are paid from the payroll account. startingGapNear is how short payroll is when the demo is reset.

intents._note: NEAR Intents has no test network. This is a REAL price quote (dry run) for the cross-chain step; no money moves. The receiving address is a placeholder because the quote service only accepts main-network addresses.

demoScaleLabel: Demo scale — testnet amounts shown at real-world size

tidepool._note: REAL testnet swap through Tidepool, a community-run NEAR Intents sandbox (not run by NEAR). Tokens are test tokens with no value. The DAO sends test USDC to a one-time deposit address; Tidepool pays test wNEAR back to the DAO. Small fixed amount, not the demo-scale gap.
tidepool.label: NEAR Intents testnet (Tidepool, community sandbox)

limits._note: Hard ceilings checked on the server for every request. The payout list lives in the browser (no database), so these cap what a hand-made request can ask for.
